blockers.summary: Positive intermediate underflow and subnormal precision loss in Gamma-family scale transformations
Gamma/Chi-square density, CDF and survival lose a positive standardized argument
Gamma/Chi-square inverse discards a representable quantile at the unit scale
Main-grid rows without a contract or exemption disposition
Post-fix evidence for the off-grid Stirling prefactor repair is incomplete

resolution.evidence: The frozen #23 wave is recorded in gamma_series_small_shape/WAVE_RESULT.md (run 42365758589, 955/955; 44 untouched holdout rows and 5 probes/counterexamples pass 3E-15; falsified B4 is retained and explained). Run 42421734701 at f157e67 revalidated all four frozen #13 cutoff claims (48/40/48/48 bits). Run 42422488108 at 2d7a775 passed 955/955 and freshly exported the main grid with five promoted representative rows plus the global holdout. All five new rows meet 3E-15; the 2088 existing main observations and global holdout are unchanged. See gamma_series_small_shape/COMPLETION_RESULT.md. No contract relaxed; 27-row coverage debt unchanged. #13 production wiring and #26 residual survival defect remain open.

blockers.summary: Incomplete-gamma Q amplifies lower-series error by forming 1 - P
Post-prefactor-fix continued-fraction Q survival still breaches 5E-15 (worst 4.53E-14); residual decomposition and repair remain

resolution.evidence: PR #242 routes public Gamma P/Q through the scaled double-double kernel: the 41 retained public failures are resolved without changing a tolerance, the frozen fresh validation (protocol 5c23f63, 206 forward points and 24 inverse references) passes, and run 42670065251 passed 14,886/14,886 with no main or holdout observation changed (166/166 main, 83/83 holdout contracts; review fixes in gamma_cf_study/coverage/REVIEW_FIX_PREDICTIONS.md). PR #289 promotes the frozen X = 2 survival ladder into the main grid as 24 Gamma and Chi-square rows claiming 5E-15; run 42679149964 returned the predicted model value at all 24, worst 7.2E-17, and changed no other observation (gamma_cf_study/MAIN_GRID_PROMOTION.md). The cause is identified by the #235 decomposition: finite-fraction truncation at the Lentz stop. No contract relaxed; 27-row coverage debt unchanged. #24 remains open.

blockers.summary: Student-t CDF, survival and inverse lose upper-tail accuracy at large df

resolution.evidence: The large-df tail route (PROB_TF_StudentTLargeDFTail) and the inverse polish ship under two frozen preregistrations. Excel VBA Regression run 42260290029 at 9cbe5d9 passed 955/955 and exported the main grid, tchi_large_df and the holdout: all 30 polished inverse rows fell in their predicted outcome sets, 616 other Student-t, density and F rows were bit-identical, and 56 untouched holdout rows met their predictions (worst 2.8E-16). The Student-t survival, cumulative and quantile envelope_domain contracts are now 5E-15 over df 1E5..1E8 (benchmark/student_t_large_df_study/INVERSE_WAVE_RESULT.md).

blockers.summary: Normal upper-tail kernel loses relative accuracy beyond z = 3 and through its exponential factor

resolution.evidence: The repaired normal upper-tail kernel (PROB_NormalUpperTail, PROB_ExpNegHalfSquare) ships through #81, merged into release/1.0.0 as ba39243. Excel VBA Regression run 42210983927 exported the main grid, the holdout and holdout_older in the same job as a green regression, and run 42231334906 exported survival_boundary; 222 of 223 preregistered rows met their predictions (normal_tail_study/excel_wave_check.json and excel_wave_check_survival_boundary.json), and the NormalStandard, Normal and Lognormal survival contracts were set on that evidence. #72 was closed on 2026-11-06 with that Resolution; this entry had been left open.
